subject.title: Allow up to six Overview providers

question: Should an upgrade preserve the legacy implicit three-provider Overview selection, or should users with no stored selection automatically expand to six providers?
rationale: An empty persisted selection currently has defined fallback semantics, so changing the shared cap also changes established user state; tests alone cannot determine the intended upgrade policy.

options.title: Preserve existing implicit selections
options.body: Migrate pre-existing empty selections to the legacy first-three set once, while fresh installs and explicit selections can use six providers.

options.title: Adopt six on every upgrade
options.body: Accept that users without an explicit stored selection will see up to six Overview providers after updating, and document that intentional layout change.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing implicit selections
recommendation.body: Migrate pre-existing empty selections to the legacy first-three set once, while fresh installs and explicit selections can use six providers.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a shared settings-default and product-behavior decision rather than a mechanical test correction.
